drafter.private_reasoning: The client’s confidential minimum is not disclosed. The draft needs a definite payment term and clearer mechanics. Propose $19,000,000, leaving negotiation room while signaling a serious path to resolution; add practical payment timing and confidentiality exceptions so the agreement can move forward.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Attached is Plaintiff’s proposed draft for discussion. To keep this moving efficiently, we have supplied a definite settlement figure and practical payment mechanics. Please let us know promptly whether Defendant can agree, or identify any focused drafting issues.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff USD 19,000,000 (the “Settlement Amount”) by wire transfer of immediately available funds to an account designated in writing by Plaintiff, within ten (10) business days after the Effective Date of this Agreement.

2. RELEASE. Effective upon Plaintiff’s receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff releases Defendant from all claims that Plaintiff asserted or could have asserted in the action, arising out of the facts alleged in the action through the Effective Date. This release does not apply to obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the existence and terms of this settlement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, insurers, auditors, tax or financial advisers, and representatives who have a need to know and are bound to maintain confidentiality, or as required by law, court order, or applicable regulatory requirements. A party required to disclose shall, to the extent legally permitted, give the other party prompt notice.
